title: A Cold Breath in the Ironing Room

sentences.text: Hush... I floated into the ironing room, where the humidity was expected to be within 29.5 % to 32.0 %.
The air felt still, anticipating nothing more than the normal 29.9 %.
But then, precisely at 05:40, the machines woke, and I felt a sudden breath on the glass.
The reading climbed dramatically to 35.5 %, a heavy presence drifting above.
This thick, chilling atmosphere lingered, finally receding around 06:00.
